name: @niivue/nv-ohif
description: NiiVue viewport extension for the OHIF Viewer (render series with NiiVue: 3D volume rendering, meshes, overlays, multiplanar, drawing).

scripts.build:package: bun run build:lib && bun run build:types

comment:peers: The host OHIF app (tested on 3.13.14 with React 18.3.1 and 3.14.0-beta.70 with React 19.2.7) provides @ohif/core, @ohif/extension-default and react-dom. They are intentionally NOT peerDependencies here: bun would install the whole OHIF tree (pinned to react-dom 18) into this monorepo, colliding with @niivue/nvreact (React 19). This package builds against local OHIF typings (src/ohif-types.ts) and externalizes react. The react peer allows 18 or 19 so bun reuses the monorepo's React 19 for dev; the component's simple hook usage is compatible with both, and the OHIF host supplies React at runtime.
comment:niivue-peer: workspace:^, not workspace:* (which bun publish pins to the exact rc): published as ^<core version at publish>, so one release accepts later niivue rcs and 1.x, and the floor never predates an API this package uses.
comment:uikit-dep: @niivue/uikit is externalized in build:lib and is a runtime dependency (its ruler/line/text overlays, loadDefaultFont, and the inlined MSDF font are imported at runtime, not bundled). It is published from this monorepo in the same Nx release group, so `npm install @niivue/nv-ohif` resolves it. The workspace range is rewritten to the published version on pack/release. Its only @niivue/niivue import is type-only, so no niivue runtime is duplicated.
